title: SG-3 · Build playable 80/20 game frontend
summary: Playable Vite React TS frontend for The Boy's Room with 80/20 layout
description: Context: game/ holds a pure runtime (performAction, chooseOption, serializeState) and bedroom content, but no UI exists. Desired behavior: a Vite React TS app in game/frontend/ (placed under the existing game/ top-level folder) renders scene, hotspots, action menu, dialogue, choices, history and inventory in an 80/20 layout with a mobile drawer, persisting state to localStorage safely. Expected result: a player can play the opening scene. Why: first playable milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Given the app loads, When there is no history, Then the intro copy 'Every great adventure begins with a question.' is shown
Given a hotspot is clicked, When an action is chosen, Then game state updates and persists
Given storage throws, When the app runs, Then play continues in memory
Given a narrow viewport, When the drawer toggle is pressed, Then the story panel opens and collapses

out_of_scope: Contribution form and 'Suggest What Happens Next' flow
preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: All four requirements completed with Act, Verify and Evidence
